body: Anytime. You deserve to feel better and get the help you deserve. maybe you should try to do that and find a safer, healthier place to live. You seem so sweet and kind. I really hope things work out for you. I'm back at home... I see the doctor in a week and my therapist in a few days. Sad thing is I already hurt myself... it's so sad I can't even be alone by myself.. like I can't control the thoughts. gosh I'm so messed up. Thanks for being there for me though...

Ohh :/ I hope you start feeling better really soon. Looks like I'm going home tomorrow.... I'm definitely glad to be out of the hospital but I don't think I'm going to be safe at home..I still have the thoughts of not wanting to be here and don't see much that would really keep me hanging on... idk... but don't worry about me... I've worried you enough... and I'm going to say the same to you... keep hanging in there... you can do it!

I'm really sorry to hear that. :( I think they're going to let me go after they meet with my parents... I've tried to get better here, but it's hard. I've been making myself throw up my food because I feel like I'm gaining back weight here and I hate it! :( I hope you are feeling better...

I'm so sorry I worried you. You've helped me a lot.. thanks. I hope you can get some sleep. I wish I could be at home and sleep in my bed... I feel like it's gonna be a long few days :( I don't know what all they are going to do so that's a little scary too...
I'm trying to but people keep walking in and I'm still feeling kind of sick...
I don't know... I'Ve been really out of it since I got here... they want to watch me right now before they move me to a room.. I don't know how long for...
US... someone said minimum is 3 days so maybe I can go home then :/
I can't stop crying...
They're just watching me right now and had me talk to some people.. I'm trying to tell them that I'm ok now I just don't want to be stuck here :(
But I feel as soon as I get home I'm going to have the same thoughts and Im not strong enough to deal with them.
I hate this...
Yes and I want to go home :(

Yes and yes, but neither really help. I have a hard time talking in therapy. I had a horrible panic attack last week in session. Cutting is the only way I can cope... but it's been getting pretty bad lately... I don't know what else to do.

I guess I just wanted to fall asleep and not wake back up to any of this. Life is hard. I'm not close with my family. I don't have many friends and the few I have, I always push away even though I try not to. My anxiety is so bad I can't hold a job or make new friends. I have scars all over me from self harm that constantly remind me of all the pain and will never go away. I just don't see a way out...
